|birth = {{ne|736}}}}'''Sierin Vayu''' (pronounced: see-EH-rihn VEYE-oo) was the [[Amyrlin Seat]] from [[979 NE|979]] to {{Ne|984}}. She was raised from the [[Gray Ajah]] after [[Tamra Ospenya]] was murdered.

== Appearance ==
She was plump but hard eyed, with a round face and a stern bearing.

== Abilities ==
Sierin was of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|24}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sierin Vayu}}

== History ==
Sierin was born in the year {{ne|736}} and was enrolled as a [[Novice]] in the White Tower in {{ne|752}}; after eight years as Novice and nine as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|769}}.

Sierin was elected Amyrlin Seat in the year {{ne|979}}  but despite the Tradition after her election she did not grant petitions and relief from penances.

In fact she was extremely hard and strict as Amyrlin, and imposing strict disciplinary measures on the Tower, even public castigation to many Aes Sedai: she exiled three sisters from the Tower and two more were birched. 

Sierin has been described as having "more than a touch of Red in her."  Many sisters were surprised that she had chosen Gray instead of [[Red Ajah]] when she was raised to the shawl. Contravening the tradition of appointing high officials from the Amyrlin's own former Ajah, she chose [[Duhara Basaheen]] as her [[Keeper of the Chronicles]] and [[Amira Moselle]] as her [[Mistress of Novices]], both from the Red.  And she had a great reputation for misandry; she fired all the male clerks in the White Tower, for such offenses as "flirting with Novices and Accepted" or "inappropriate glances and looks," accusing even harmless elderly men and men known to be homosexual.

She was secretly warned by [[Siuan Sanche]] about the [[Black Ajah]] and its relation with the deaths of five Aes Sedai, [[Tamra Ospenya's Searchers]]. It is possible that she hinted her suspicions for she died mysteriously in {{ne|984}}; later [[Chesmal Emry]] revealed that she induced a small group of Red Ajah sisters to murder her. The Black Ajah was not directly involved.

Sierin was about to put a stop to "[[The Vileness]]", but her assassination prevented it.

==Two Keepers of the Chronicles==
The [[The Wheel of Time Companion]] states that [[Angharad Juerissen]] was Keeper of the Chronicles for Sierin Vayu as well as [[Duhara Basaheen]]. Duhara is the only one mentioned in [[New Spring]].

A possible explanation is that Duhara may have stepped down from the office in {{ne|984}} and was briefly replaced by Angharad. It's possible that Duhara's involvement in the Vileness was discovered early and she was forced to resign as Keeper and severely punished. Although we are told the Black Ajah was not involved in Sierin's murder, this does not preclude Duhara being involved or part of the reason for the Red taking action.

She was [[Tamra Ospenya]]'s successor and [[Marith Jaen]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}
